metadata: UIWeaponAttachmentMetadata lists 51 weapon AAM tables. AAM_HK433 has 94 local entries and links individual attachments to AD metadata.
sample: AD_AK126H64 contains icon atlas references and two hashed text records; no modifier arithmetic is established in this sample.
transform: WeaponAttachmentTransformDBD exposes named anchors and offsets for sights, barrels, magazines, rails and other model parts.
limitation: Metadata is useful for identity and UI cross-checks; the 51-table list is not proof of the complete multiplayer roster or current attachment availability. Transform bindings are not stat formulas.
